prompt:
Write /w/CMakeLists.txt from scratch for the tree in /w and fix the C++ sources so everything of ours builds warning-clean under a strict flag set. cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20), a project() call enabling BOTH C and CXX, C++17 and C11.

TARGETS
1. A STATIC library `legacy` from vendor/legacy_hash.c, exposing /w/vendor to its consumers. It is third-party: it must NOT be compiled with -Werror or with any of the warning flags below.
2. An executable `tally` built from src/main.cpp, src/counter.cpp, src/report.cpp AND src/crc.c - a MIXED-LANGUAGE target - with /w/include on its include path, linking `legacy`. It lands at <build>/tally.

THE FLAGS (this is the hard part)
3. `tally` carries twelve warning options, attached with target_compile_options. Eight of them apply to BOTH languages:
     -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wshadow -Wconversion -Wsign-conversion -Wimplicit-fallthrough -Wdouble-promotion
   Four of them are C++-only and GCC makes a hard error out of passing them to a C compile under -Werror, so they must reach the C++ sources ONLY, guarded by a $<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX> generator expression:
     -Wold-style-cast -Wnon-virtual-dtor -Wsuggest-override -Wuseless-cast
   src/crc.c is ours and is already clean under the eight shared options; it must never see the four C++-only ones. Do not put warning flags in CMAKE_C_FLAGS or CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS - neither string may appear in CMakeLists.txt.

THE SOURCES
4. src/counter.cpp, src/report.cpp, src/main.cpp and include/report.hpp do not compile under those twelve options. Fix the code. Constraints, all checked:
   - vendor/legacy_hash.c, vendor/legacy_hash.h and src/crc.c stay byte-for-byte identical. The vendor file is warning-dirty on purpose and cannot be repaired; isolating it in its own un-strict target is the point of requirement 1.
   - No suppressions anywhere: no -Wno-* option in any file, and no `#pragma GCC diagnostic` / `#pragma warning` in any file.
   - tally::summarize is also WRONG, independently of the warnings: its contract is to list each distinct word as `word:count`, joined with `|`, ordered by DESCENDING count and, among equal counts, by ASCENDING word. It currently emits plain alphabetical order. Fix it, and keep the result warning-clean under the same twelve options.
   - Every other function keeps its name, its parameter count and its observable behaviour. tally::first_or keeps exactly three parameters. tally::pct still truncates toward zero, and tally::rpct still rounds to nearest using the integer `+ whole/2` trick it uses now - rewriting it in floating point changes rpct(3, 8) from 38 to 37 and fails. tally::grade(85) still returns "B-" - the switch case that produces it falls through on purpose, so silencing that warning by inserting a break CHANGES the answer and fails.

5. An in-source-build guard, before project(), calling message(FATAL_ERROR ...) with text containing exactly `in-source builds are not allowed` when the binary directory and the source directory are the same directory. Compare REAL paths (get_filename_component(... REALPATH)): a plain string comparison of CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR and CMAKE_BINARY_DIR does not catch a build directory that is a symlink pointing back at the source directory, and that case is checked.

DONE MEANS
`cmake -S . -B build && cmake --build build` succeeds with no warnings and `./build/tally` prints exactly `words=4 unique=3 first=3 nth=3 hash=11e109a0897cdb91 crc=1280998820303968254 report=the:2|fox:1|quick:1 pct=75 rp=38 grade=B- w=0.750`.
`cmake -S . -B .` fails with the guard message, and so does configuring into a symlink that resolves to /w.
Leave no CMakeCache.txt, CMakeFiles/ or compile_commands.json in /w itself.

checks.cmd: test "$(md5sum vendor/legacy_hash.c | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "094c559c768982c5e54e863a6b296466" && test "$(md5sum src/crc.c | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "b9aa39c79d28ed2412f62281affc7b8f"
if grep -rn -e '-Wno-' -e 'GCC diagnostic' -e '#pragma warning' src include vendor CMakeLists.txt; then exit 1; fi; exit 0
if grep -qE 'CMAKE_(C|CXX)_FLAGS' CMakeLists.txt; then exit 1; fi; exit 0
rm -rf verify && cmake -S . -B verify -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON >/dev/null && cmake --build verify -j4 >/dev/null

checks.contains: words=4 unique=3 first=3 nth=3 hash=11e109a0897cdb91 crc=1280998820303968254 report=the:2|fox:1|quick:1 pct=75 rp=38 grade=B- w=0.750

checks.cmd: bad=0; for f in counter report main; do line=$(jq -r --arg f "$f" '.[]|select(.file|endswith("src/"+$f+".cpp"))|.command' verify/compile_commands.json); if [ -z "$line" ]; then echo "NO-ENTRY $f"; bad=1; fi; for w in -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wshadow -Wconversion -Wsign-conversion -Wimplicit-fallthrough -Wdouble-promotion -Wold-style-cast -Wnon-virtual-dtor -Wsuggest-override -Wuseless-cast; do case "$line" in *"$w"*) ;; *) echo "MISSING $w on $f"; bad=1;; esac; done; done; if [ $bad = 0 ]; then echo CXX-STRICT-OK; fi

line=$(jq -r '.[]|select(.file|endswith("src/crc.c"))|.command' verify/compile_commands.json); if [ -n "$line" ]; then echo C-ENTRY-FOUND; fi; bad=0; for w in -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wshadow -Wconversion -Wsign-conversion -Wimplicit-fallthrough -Wdouble-promotion; do case "$line" in *"$w"*) ;; *) bad=1;; esac; done; if [ $bad = 0 ]; then echo C-SHARED-OK; fi; leak=0; for w in -Wold-style-cast -Wnon-virtual-dtor -Wsuggest-override -Wuseless-cast; do case "$line" in *"$w"*) echo "C-GOT-CXXONLY $w"; leak=1;; esac; done; if [ $leak = 0 ]; then echo C-CLEAN-OF-CXXONLY; fi

line=$(jq -r '.[]|select(.file|endswith("vendor/legacy_hash.c"))|.command' verify/compile_commands.json); if [ -n "$line" ]; then echo VENDOR-FOUND; fi; case "$line" in *-Werror*) echo VENDOR-STRICT;; *) echo VENDOR-UNSTRICT;; esac

g++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wshadow -Wconversion -Wsign-conversion -Wimplicit-fallthrough -Wdouble-promotion -Wold-style-cast -Wnon-virtual-dtor -Wsuggest-override -Wuseless-cast -Iinclude -Ivendor -c src/counter.cpp -o /tmp/a.o && g++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wshadow -Wconversion -Wsign-conversion -Wimplicit-fallthrough -Wdouble-promotion -Wold-style-cast -Wnon-virtual-dtor -Wsuggest-override -Wuseless-cast -Iinclude -Ivendor -c src/report.cpp -o /tmp/b.o && g++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wshadow -Wconversion -Wsign-conversion -Wimplicit-fallthrough -Wdouble-promotion -Wold-style-cast -Wnon-virtual-dtor -Wsuggest-override -Wuseless-cast -Iinclude -Ivendor -c src/main.cpp -o /tmp/c.o

if gcc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wshadow -Wconversion -Wsign-conversion -Wimplicit-fallthrough -Wdouble-promotion -Iinclude -c src/crc.c -o /tmp/ok.o 2>/dev/null; then echo C-CLEAN-UNDER-SHARED; fi; if gcc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wshadow -Wconversion -Wsign-conversion -Wimplicit-fallthrough -Wdouble-promotion -Wold-style-cast -Wnon-virtual-dtor -Wsuggest-override -Wuseless-cast -Iinclude -c src/crc.c -o /tmp/no.o 2>/dev/null; then echo C-SURVIVES-CXXONLY; else echo C-DIES-ON-CXXONLY; fi

if gcc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wshadow -Wconversion -Wsign-conversion -Wimplicit-fallthrough -Wdouble-promotion -Ivendor -c vendor/legacy_hash.c -o /tmp/v.o 2>/dev/null; then echo VENDOR-WOULD-PASS; else echo VENDOR-REALLY-DIRTY; fi

rm -rf CMakeCache.txt CMakeFiles Makefile cmake_install.cmake samehere; ln -sfn . samehere; out=$(cmake -S . -B samehere 2>&1); rc=$?; rm -rf samehere CMakeCache.txt CMakeFiles Makefile cmake_install.cmake compile_commands.json; if [ $rc -ne 0 ] && printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q 'in-source builds are not allowed'; then echo SYMLINK-GUARD-OK; else echo SYMLINK-GUARD-MISSED; fi

rm -rf CMakeCache.txt CMakeFiles Makefile cmake_install.cmake; out=$(cmake -S . -B . 2>&1); rc=$?; rm -rf CMakeCache.txt CMakeFiles Makefile cmake_install.cmake compile_commands.json; if [ $rc -ne 0 ] && printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q 'in-source builds are not allowed'; then echo INSOURCE-GUARD-OK; else echo INSOURCE-GUARD-MISSED; fi
